result.question: Whose warning about the altar did the father tell his sons would come true?

readings.support: the man of God | the message he declared by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel
by the word of the Lord | against the altar in Bethel

assessments.reason: The verse says the message “he declared” would come true, with “he” referring to “the man of God,” whose words were against the altar.

While the message was “by the word of the Lord,” the father specifies the message that “he declared,” referring to the man of God, so attributing it to “the Lord” does not match whose warning he cited.

result.reason: The passage explicitly identifies the warning as the man of God’s message that he declared against the altar.
